svg.text: IT Procurement Intelligence Platform — system architecture
Docker Compose deployment · verified against the repository (branch anjali, October 2026)
Web browser (and API clients) — React 18 + TypeScript SPA (Vite, Tailwind)
Roles: requester · approver · finance · admin (role-specific navigation; RoleGuard is UX only)
Access token (JWT) in memory · refresh token in httpOnly cookie + CSRF header
Serves the built SPA · /api/<prefix> → service · rate limits on auth endpoints · CSP & security headers · 25 MB body cap · sets X-Correlation-ID
APPLICATION SERVICES (FastAPI, Python 3.11) — each also listed with its gateway routes
gRPC: start/signal workflows; workers poll task queues
Event backbone — Kafka API (Redpanda) · 23 topics · per-service SASL/SCRAM logins and ACLs
document.ingested (6 partitions) → worker · document.classified, vendor.matched → approval, contract, notification · approval.requested/decided → contract, notification, document

contract.generated/signed → approval, notification · invoice.matched → approval · risk.score.updated, contract.renewal.due, license.usage.updated, vendor.* → notification · business_rule.updated → agents
Each service migrates its own tables
polled every 3 s by the worker;
INSTREAM scan of every upload; fails closed
used by: auth, notification, doc worker
Service-to-service calls (synchronous HTTP inside the Docker network)
document-vendor worker → approval-inventory: POST /invoices/match (books the invoice; service JWT)
chatbot → contract-risk: GET /vendors/, /vendors/{id}/risk (2 and 3 use a JWT minted for the user)
notification → approval-inventory: mint a single-use email-approval link
